Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used RNA Affinity Purification (RAP-MS) to identify proteins interacting with VHL mRNA. The proteomics analysis was performed using a bottom-up DDA approach with label-free quantification (MaxLFQ and iBAQ).

scope: We performed an RNA affinity purification to pull down VHL mRNA with its bound protein complexes from WT and NSExt mutant cell lines and identified the bound proteins by mass spectrometry (RAP-MS)
The RNA-protein complexes were then pulled down by streptavidin beads, the bound proteins were isolated and subjected to mass-spectrometry based identification.
Protein content after an immunoprecipitation experiment using 20 million HEK293 cells per sample was run for 0.5 cm into an SDS-PAGE and the entire piece was cut out and digested using trypsin

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on proteins affinity-purified via RNA affinity purification (RAP-MS) using biotinylated DNA probes (raPOOLs) and streptavidin beads to capture VHL mRNA-protein complexes.
